note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 22 November 2026, RealHunt lists 21 homes for sale in Portugal, each one checked by a person.
In Portugal, the median asking price of those 21 homes is €130,000 (€1,364 per m², from the 21 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €48,000 and the most expensive €189,000.
Taxes and fees add about 3–12% to the price of a home in Portugal (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: IMT transfer tax 0-8% (progressive) + stamp duty 0.8% + notary/registry 0.9-1.2% + legal 1.25-2%.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes, same rights as Portuguese citizens (IMT increase for foreign second-home buyers announced Sept 2025).
buying.annual_property_tax: IMI 0.3-0.45% of taxable value (urban), set by municipality.
buying.rental_income_tax: Long-term: 25% flat for non-residents; short-term (AL) under the simplified regime only 35-50% of gross is taxable.

homes.title: Restored single-storey Alentejo house with reed ceilings near Mértola
homes.title_es: Casa alentejana de una planta rehabilitada con techos de caña cerca de Mértola
homes.summary: A typical single-storey Alentejo house in Penilhos, about 20 km from Mértola and 25 km from Castro Verde. Recently rehabilitated keeping the original features: traditional wooden interior doors, reed ceilings and an Alentejo kitchen. Living room, kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, in good condition. Easy access and parking in the street. Asking €68,500, about €913/m².

homes.title: Five-bedroom house with garage and balconies in a Trás-os-Montes village near Miranda do Douro
homes.title_es: Casa de cinco dormitorios con garaje y balcones en una aldea de Trás-os-Montes cerca de Miranda do Douro
homes.place: São Pedro da Silva, Miranda do Douro, Bragança
homes.summary: A five-bedroom house in the centre of São Pedro da Silva, in Miranda do Douro. 238 m² of built area over three floors with a garage and balconies, and bright rooms with wooden floors. A roomy home for a large family or a second residence in Trás-os-Montes. Asking €100,000, about €633/m².

homes.title: Five-bedroom house with two kitchens, central heating and a new roof in Silvares, Fundão
homes.title_es: Casa de cinco dormitorios con dos cocinas, calefacción central y tejado nuevo en Silvares, Fundão
homes.summary: A five-bedroom house on four floors in Silvares, with good-sized rooms throughout. Two fitted kitchens, two bathrooms, a large living and dining room, a basement and an attic. Balconies look out over the village, there is central heating and the roof was renovated recently. Energy certificate D. Asking €110,000, about €625/m².

homes.title: Fully remodelled Alentejo village house with wooden ceilings in Chança, Alter do Chão
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo alentejana totalmente reformada con techos de madera en Chança, Alter do Chão
homes.summary: A fully remodelled semi-detached house in Chança, a calm Alentejo village in Alter do Chão. White rooms under painted wooden ceilings, a new fitted kitchen, air conditioning and a mezzanine room against an exposed stone wall. Ready to move into. Energy certificate D. Asking €115,000, about €885/m².

homes.title: Furnished three-bedroom house ready to move into, 5 km from Vila Nova de Paiva
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios amueblada y lista para entrar, a 5 km de Vila Nova de Paiva
homes.place: Touro, Vila Nova de Paiva, Viseu
homes.summary: A three-bedroom house sold fully furnished and ready to live in, in a quiet spot 5 km from Vila Nova de Paiva. Solid structure with granite stone walls, an interior in good condition with no signs of damp. Large kitchen with a fireplace, dining room, three bedrooms and a bathroom. The furniture is classic Portuguese carved wood. Asking €117,500, about €816/m².

homes.title: Detached five-bedroom house with garden, garage and central heating in Brunhoso, Mogadouro
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de cinco dormitorios con jardín, garaje y calefacción central en Brunhoso, Mogadouro
homes.summary: A detached house open on all four sides in the quiet village of Brunhoso. The ground floor has a good garage, a laundry, a shower room and the boiler for the central heating, plus a garden with a barbecue area and a borehole. The first floor has a fitted kitchen with an open fireplace and a balcony, a living room and a dining room. Asking €125,000, about €735/m².

homes.title: Fully remodelled three-storey house 50 metres from the town gates of Castelo de Vide
homes.title_es: Casa de tres plantas totalmente reformada a 50 metros de las puertas de Castelo de Vide
homes.summary: A fully remodelled house on three floors in the heart of Castelo de Vide, 50 metres from the town gates and the historic centre. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms, a new white kitchen and pine floors upstairs. 126 m², whitewashed outside like the rest of the street. Asking €145,000, about €1,151/m².

homes.title: Furnished village house with terrace and hill views, ready to move into, in Mação
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo amueblada con terraza y vistas a la sierra, lista para entrar, en Mação
homes.summary: A house on two floors in the quiet village of Castelo, in Mação, in excellent condition and sold furnished. Upstairs a large living room with a wood burner and an open, fully equipped kitchen, plus bedrooms with fitted wardrobes that look over the green hills. A sitting room and a bathroom downstairs, and a terrace. Asking €145,000, about €1,510/m².

homes.title: Renovated two-bedroom house with air conditioning in the historic quarter of Estremoz
homes.title_es: Casa de dos dormitorios renovada con aire acondicionado en el casco histórico de Estremoz
homes.summary: A two-bedroom house in the historic quarter of Estremoz, renovated with respect for its original lines. Recent work on the roof and new window frames, and air conditioning in four rooms for the Alentejo summer and winter. Ready to move into. Asking €150,000, about €1,364/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated three-storey village house in Peso, Covilhã, below Serra da Estrela
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de tres plantas totalmente renovada en Peso, Covilhã, a los pies de la Serra da Estrela
homes.summary: A fully renovated townhouse in the centre of Peso, close to shops and services. Open-plan kitchen and living room with a guest WC on the ground floor, a bright bedroom on the first floor, and a second bedroom with a full bathroom on the top floor. PVC double-glazed windows throughout. Asking €150,000, about €1,744/m².

homes.title: Two-bed village house with terrace in Portugal's Dão wine country
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 2 dormitorios con terraza en la región vinícola del Dão
homes.summary: A T2 house with a terrace in Sobral, Carregal do Sal, in the Dão wine region: kitchen, living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom on the main floor, plus large storage rooms on the ground floor; about 134 m² over several levels. A home, a holiday house or a rental.

homes.title: Renovated stone house with Douro valley views in Samodães, Lamego, sold furnished
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada con vistas al valle del Duero en Samodães, Lamego, vendida amueblada
homes.summary: A traditional house in Samodães, above the Douro near Lamego, fully rebuilt and renovated in 2025 and sold furnished and equipped. 70 m² on two floors: a living room with exposed schist walls, new beams, a kitchenette and a dining table downstairs, two bedrooms and a shower room upstairs. The windows look across terraced vineyards to a bend of the river. It already holds a local lodging licence (AL), so it can be used as a home or let to visitors. Freshly whitewashed outside with new wooden shutters. Private sale. Asking €99,000, about €1,415/m².

homes.title: Freshly painted three-bedroom village house near the Sabor lakes
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo recién pintada de tres dormitorios junto a los lagos del Sabor
homes.summary: A bright yellow-and-blue two-storey house in Brunhoso, 8 km from Mogadouro: a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom downstairs, three bedrooms and a balcony upstairs, with a fireplace. Newly painted and tiled. Close to the Sabor river and lakes; good for holidays, rural rest or a small tourism let. Asking €48,000, about €480/m².

homes.title: Renovated, furnished flat in a garden resort with pool near Tavira
homes.title_es: Apartamento reformado y amueblado en un resort ajardinado con piscina cerca de Tavira
homes.summary: A 68 m² flat in the Colina Verde Resort in Moncarapacho, among olive trees, palms and lawns a few kilometres from the Algarve coast between Tavira and Olhão. Recently renovated and sold fully furnished: a large, bright living and dining room flowing into an open kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, with the resort's pool and gardens outside. Faro airport is 25 minutes away.

homes.title: Renovated detached house with open hill views in the eastern Algarve, near Alcoutim
homes.title_es: Casa aislada renovada con vistas abiertas a las colinas en el este del Algarve, cerca de Alcoutim
homes.summary: A detached single-storey house with a new tiled roof and an Algarve chimney at the edge of a small hill village, about 15 km from Alcoutim. Recently renovated and ready to move into: 77 m² with an open kitchen and living room, white units with dark worktops and built-in appliances, a bedroom plus a second room, and a shower room with glass bricks. Open views over the hills of the eastern Algarve. The advert puts Mértola and Vila Real de Santo António around 30 km away. Asking €130,000, about €1,690/m², low for a finished house in the Algarve.

homes.title: Fully renovated three-bedroom granite house in a quiet village near Tábua
homes.title_es: Casa de granito de tres dormitorios completamente renovada en un pueblo tranquilo cerca de Tábua
homes.summary: A granite village house rebuilt inside from top to bottom, about 5 km from the town of Tábua. The advert lists new windows, doors and shutters, new wiring and plumbing, rock-wool insulation on the inner walls, recessed lighting and a new fitted kitchen, so there is nothing left to do. Ground floor with open kitchen, living room and WC, and a first floor with three bedrooms, a full bathroom and a spare room for laundry or office. About 142 m2 of built area, 125 m2 useful. Energy class C, which is unusual for a stone house at this price.

homes.title: Three-bedroom village house with terrace and Serra da Lousã views near Penacova
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de tres dormitorios con terraza y vistas a la Serra da Lousã cerca de Penacova
homes.summary: A neat three-storey village house in Paradela da Cortiça with an open view of the Serra da Lousã. It keeps its original doors, wooden ceilings and floors and granite details, with aluminium windows. The main floor has a kitchen with open fireplace and dining area, a living room with balcony, three bedrooms and a full bathroom, opening onto a terrace and garden. Below are a garage and a workshop, above a large attic, and outside a shed with barbecue and wood oven. Shops are 5 to 10 minutes away, several river beaches 20 to 30 minutes, and Coimbra about 45 minutes. Energy class F.

homes.title: Two-bedroom house with fenced garden and river views near Marvão, Alentejo
homes.title_es: Casa de dos dormitorios con jardín vallado y vistas al río cerca de Marvão, Alentejo
homes.summary: A bright 70 m2 house in the quiet Ponte Velha area below Marvão, with river and mountain views, on a fully fenced 476 m2 plot with grapevines, olive trees and a persimmon tree. Two double bedrooms, a living room with a pellet stove, a kitchen with gas oven and a new water heater, and one bathroom, dated but clean. Two annexes could become a separate small unit. The advert puts the river pool and cafes of Portagem 5 minutes away, Marvão and Castelo de Vide 15 minutes, and says the licence and land registry papers are ready. The portal files it under Pernes; the text places it near Marvão.

homes.title: Renovated furnished cottage on 860 m2 of land in Lajes do Pico, Azores
homes.title_es: Casa de campo renovada y amueblada en 860 m² de terreno en Lajes do Pico, Azores
homes.summary: A fully renovated stone cottage in Silveira, 3 km from the old whaling town of Lajes on Pico island, sold furnished and equipped. 84 m2 of built area on two floors with a bedroom, living room, new fitted kitchen and modern shower room, plus air conditioning and fibre internet. Energy class C. It stands on 860 m2 of land with parking and fruit trees, all classed as urban, and the advert says about 388 m2 more could be built subject to permission. School 1 km away, Pico airport 30 minutes. Only one bedroom.

homes.title: Renovated two-bedroom whitewashed cottage in Alcaria Ruiva, near Mértola, Alentejo
homes.title_es: Cabaña encalada de dos dormitorios renovada en Alcaria Ruiva, cerca de Mértola, Alentejo
homes.summary: A single-storey Alentejo cottage with blue trim and a red door on a cobbled street in Alcaria Ruiva. It was renovated in 2025 with a new white fitted kitchen, a new shower room, new wiring and new plumbing, so it is ready to use. About 46 m² with a living and dining room, two bedrooms and one bathroom. The village is quiet but lived in, and travelling sellers bring bread, vegetables and fish to the door. Mértola and Castro Verde are both under 30 minutes away by car for supermarkets and restaurants. Asking €95,000.

homes.title: Fully restored granite house with a private garden in Bravães, Ponte da Barca
homes.title_es: Casa de granito completamente restaurada con jardín privado en Bravães, Ponte da Barca
homes.place: Bravães, Ponte da Barca, Viana do Castelo
homes.summary: A traditional Minho house in Bravães, a few minutes from the centre of Ponte da Barca, restored from top to bottom with a completely new roof. The works kept the exposed granite walls and the stone window seats and added a white fitted kitchen, pine ceilings, new floors and two bathrooms. Two bedrooms plus an extra room that can serve as an office, 74 m² in all, and a walled private garden with lawn. Good sun and quick access to the IC28 towards Viana do Castelo, Braga and Galicia. Built in 1937, energy certificate E. Asking €156,000.
